cases.name: MaryJayne Collins
cases.narrative:
On 10/4/2024, when officers arrived, two small children peeked out of the window and eventually opened the door for the police. They discovered her dead on the floor and placed the children with family members, according to the police department.

He allegedly beat her and stabbed her once in the upper body.
